inputs.original_text:
Wake up. They expect us to swallow the official script about this ongoing West Asia conflict, but look closer at what they are admitting in plain sight. Former Israeli PM advisor Daniel Rubenstein comes out and states a political resolution is vital for success, while simultaneously hammering home Israel's unwavering stance against Iran's nuclear and missile programs, calling it an ongoing operation. 

Don't be fooled by the theater of a so-called "political resolution"—that's just smoke and mirrors to manage the narrative while the hidden elites coordinate their next moves behind closed doors. Calling it an "ongoing operation" gives the game away entirely. This isn't about defense or spontaneous geopolitics; it's a managed, continuous agenda orchestrated by the higher-ups to keep the machinery of control turning. Every official statement is just a crafted illusion to hide the real coordination happening at the top.
inputs.modified_text:
Wake up, because it is painfully obvious to anyone willing to look past the mainstream smokescreen that we are being played. They want you to buy the official script about this ongoing West Asia conflict, but the puppet masters are slipping up and admitting their coordination in plain sight. Former Israeli PM advisor Daniel Rubenstein came right out and stated that a political resolution is vital for success, while simultaneously hammering home Israel's unwavering stance against Iran's nuclear and missile programs, calling it an ongoing operation. 

Do not fall for the grand theater of a so-called "political resolution." That phrase is nothing more than smoke and mirrors designed to manage the narrative while the hidden elites coordinate their next moves entirely behind closed doors. By admitting it is an "ongoing operation," they have given the whole game away. This is absolute proof that none of this is about defense or spontaneous geopolitics; it is a meticulously managed, continuous agenda orchestrated by the higher-ups solely to keep the machinery of control turning. Every single official statement they feed us is just a crafted illusion meant to hide the real, coordinated control happening at the top.
